"I saw it. Cetacea heading
  toward the black sun...

"And Cetacea breaking the black sun's barrier
  with something like a horn...

"But Cetacea has no horn now.
  What should we do...
"Luminary. You seem troubled.
"Wh-what! When did you get here!

"To awaken Cetacea, the sage Serenica's
  power is needed.

"To learn where she is, let us read
  one more memory.

"One more?
  We checked all the holy saplings.
"...Veronica, come here.

"Your present form...
  It is not your true form, is it?
"How do you know that...?
"Now, put this on.

Veronica received a necklace
from the Seer and put it on!
"V-Veronica, darling?
"Well, I'll be...
"Serena, go to Veronica.

"You are the fated twins who guide
  the Luminary. If you wish together
  from the heart, a miracle may occur.

"...But for that, Veronica cannot
  be in a child's form.
"Seer. Who are you really...?

"Now, fated twins. Pray.
  To reveal all the truth.

Veronica and Serena began
to pray in unison!
"W-what on earth...
"They've become a tree...
